title: Story pack: Decoded #6 is out (Creative Fatigue)
hook: Three kinds of ad fatigue look the same on a dashboard. Only one means cut.
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

Announces Decoded #6: Creative Fatigue: When to Refresh, When to Cut. Frame 1 is the issue title. Frame 2 gives the three kinds of fatigue. Frame 3 is the poll. Frame 4 sends people to the issue with a link sticker.
alt_text: Four vertical story frames. Frame 1: Decoded #6, Creative Fatigue: When to Refresh, When to Cut, out today. Frame 2 lists three kinds of fatigue: tired opening, refresh it; saturated audience, shift it; reason to buy stopped working, cut it. Frame 3 is a poll: your best ad gets dearer, first move? Frame 4 asks people to read Decoded #6 free using the link sticker.
cta: Tap the link sticker to read Decoded #6
